mission_prompt: Enterprise RFP Proposal & Pricing Factory: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Read the uploaded government cloud migration RFP file (PDF/Word), extract raw text, and structure it into a tabular format suitable for downstream analysis. If the document is not available, synthesize a realistic RFP baseline dataset with typical sections such as Scope, Technical Requirements, Evaluation Criteria, and Pricing Guidelines.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: Structured data frame containing key RFP sections and raw text content for each section.

units.description: Analyze the parsed RFP text to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Produce a list of criteria with brief descriptions and any associated scoring or weighting information.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: JSON array of compliance criteria objects: {id, description, weight, source_section}.

units.description: Using the compliance list, design a multi-tier labor pricing model that assigns cost rates to each required skill set (e.g., cloud architect, security engineer, project manager). Calculate total labor costs per tier and generate a summary table of projected expenses for the migration project.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing matrix CSV/JSON with tiers, hourly rates, estimated hours per compliance item, and subtotal totals.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Create a polished executive proposal document that includes an executive summary, solution overview, compliance mapping, pricing breakdown, and a traceability matrix linking each proposal section to the corresponding RFP compliance criteria. Format the output as a PDF-ready Markdown or Word template.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2, t3]
units.output_contract: Final proposal document (Markdown/Word) with embedded traceability table and clear references to compliance items.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive RFP proposal for a government cloud migration project, including mandatory technical compliance extraction, multi-tier labor pricing model, and a traceability matrix linking proposal content to each compliance requirement.
dag.reasoning: The request requires multiple distinct phases: ingesting the RFP document, extracting compliance criteria, building a detailed pricing model, and synthesizing an executive proposal with traceability. Each phase is independent yet sequentially dependent on the previous outputs, so four tasks are appropriate for clear separation of concerns while staying within the 12‑task limit.
